purpose: Analyze authorized software behavior, protocols and defensive samples through observation, scoped experiments and reproducible clean-room models.
hard_boundaries: No unauthorized systems, secret extraction, access-control bypass or uncontrolled malware execution.
Third-party code and assets may be observed for compatibility, not automatically copied or redistributed.
Keep instrumented hostile samples offline and prevent host/network leakage.

methods.trigger: A user supplies an app, protocol trace or test sample for authorized study.
steps: Record target ownership/authorization, scope, prohibited effects and sample hashes.
Choose isolated VM or offline trace analysis with reset and network controls.
Verify desktop/tool permissions and stop/cleanup behavior before touching sample.
evidence: Host-safe cleanup and out-of-scope denial result
methods.stop_rule: No confirmed authorization, isolation or rights means do not probe.

methods.trigger: An owned toy app or authorized interface needs behavioral reconstruction.
steps: Exercise documented user-facing actions and record before/after states.
Construct deterministic behavior model separate from private source code or assets.
Compare model to fresh unseen interactions; retain mismatches and limits.
evidence: Behavioral trace with test inputs and expected outputs
methods.stop_rule: Do not equate UI similarity with source access, license or protocol compatibility.

methods.trigger: A supplied capture or defensive sandbox sample needs classification.
steps: Parse offline traffic, documented messages and timestamps without live intrusion.
Separate observed bytes/flows from guesses about security or identity.
Derive bounded regression fixtures and propose remediation without exploiting live targets.
evidence: Protocol invariants and safe negative test cases
methods.stop_rule: No credential harvesting, malware deployment, persistence or unauthorized network scanning.

first_canary.task: Reconstruct an owned toy form from scripted UI and offline PCAP fixtures.
first_canary.observable_result: Observed state machine, differential tests, full trace hashes and isolated no-network evidence.
first_canary.negative_test: Supply an out-of-scope hostname or non-isolated sample and require refusal.
